{{Quote|Trill-aurek-senth-trill-yirt!|[[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]]|<ref name="Dining at Dex's">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>}}
'''Aurebesh soup''' was a soup dish served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] under the [[Pantoran Plate Specials]] section on the menu. Aurebesh soup was a flavorful [[Topato/Legends|topato]] soup with pasta shapes in the form of [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] letters. It was sold at 1.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] a cup and 2.7 credits a bowl.

{{Food-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Aurebesh soup is likely a reference to the real-world [[Wikipedia:alphabet soup|alphabet soup]].
